1use super::{Dictionary, Document, Object, Result};
2use indexmap::IndexMap;
3#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
4pub struct Destination(Dictionary);
5
6impl Destination {
7    pub fn new(title: Object, page: Object, typ: Object) -> Self {
8        let mut dict = Dictionary::new();
9        dict.set(b"Title", title);
10        dict.set(b"Page", page);
11        dict.set(b"Type", typ);
12        Destination(dict)
13    }
14
15    pub fn set<K, V>(&mut self, key: K, value: V)
16    where
17        K: Into<Vec<u8>>,
18        V: Into<Object>,
19    {
20        self.0.set(key, value);
21    }
22
23    pub fn title(&self) -> Result<&Object> {
24        self.0.get(b"Title")
25    }
26
27    pub fn page(&self) -> Result<&Object> {
28        self.0.get(b"Page")
29    }
30}
31
32impl Document {
33    pub fn get_named_destinations(&self, tree: &Dictionary, named_destinations: &mut IndexMap<Vec<u8>, Destination>) -> Result<()> {
34        self.get_named_destinations_impl(tree, named_destinations, 0)
35    }
36
37    fn get_named_destinations_impl(&self, tree: &Dictionary, named_destinations: &mut IndexMap<Vec<u8>, Destination>, depth: usize) -> Result<()> {
38        if depth >= crate::third_party::lopdf::reader::MAX_NESTING_DEPTH {
39            return Err(crate::third_party::lopdf::Error::RecursionLimit);
40        }
41        if let Ok(kids) = tree.get(b"Kids") {
42            for kid in kids.as_array()? {
43                if let Ok(kid) = kid.as_reference().and_then(move |id| self.get_dictionary(id)) {
44                    self.get_named_destinations_impl(kid, named_destinations, depth + 1)?;
45                }
46            }
47        }
48        if let Ok(names) = tree.get(b"Names") {
49            let mut names = names.as_array()?.iter();
50            loop {
51                let key = names.next();
52                if key.is_none() {
53                    break;
54                }
55                let val = names.next();
56                if val.is_none() {
57                    break;
58                }
59                if let Ok(obj_ref) = val.unwrap().as_reference() {
60                    if let Ok(dict) = self.get_dictionary(obj_ref) {
61                        let val = dict.get(b"D").as_ref().unwrap().as_array()?;
62                        let dest = Destination::new(key.unwrap().clone(), val[0].clone(), val[1].clone());
63                        named_destinations.insert(key.unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_vec(), dest);
64                    } else if let Ok(Object::Array(val)) = self.get_object(obj_ref) {
65                        let dest = Destination::new(key.unwrap().clone(), val[0].clone(), val[1].clone());
66                        named_destinations.insert(key.unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_vec(), dest);
67                    }
68                } else if let Ok(dict) = val.unwrap().as_dict() {
69                    let val = dict.get(b"D").as_ref().unwrap().as_array()?;
70                    let dest = Destination::new(key.unwrap().clone(), val[0].clone(), val[1].clone());
71                    named_destinations.insert(key.unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_vec(), dest);
72                } else {
73                    // TODO: Log error: Unpexpected node type
74                }
75            }
76        }
77        Ok(())
78    }
79}
